title: ATS Gui
features:
Auto Kill - Auto teleport to nearest mob attack and use abilities on cooldown.

Auto Train - Auto teleport to training area and use all spirit to train strength.

Auto Rebirth - Self Explanatory.

Santa Hunter - Will actively hunt Santa when he spawns teleporting away from whatever you may be killing at the moment Auto Kill must be on for it to work.

Select Mob - You can select Kill All for the old functionality of killing everything nearby. You can also select a mob from the list to kill repeatedly. 

Auto Kill and Auto Train can not be active at the same time.
